card.text: M92 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 8,500 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 92 is a globular cluster of stars in the northern constellation of Hercules.

introduction.text: M92 is drawn as 2,547 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
